name: autoclip
description: AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。Open-source AI video clipping & content repurposing.
one_liner: Give it a link to a long podcast, interview, or stream and it automatically cuts out the best short clips, adds captions and a cover image, and writes a caption ready to post on TikTok or Shorts.
buyer: A solo content creator or small podcast who knows they should be posting short clips every day but can't afford a video editor and doesn't have the hours to do it themselves.
business_use_cases: A freelance 'podcast-to-shorts' editor builds a per-episode service for creators and podcasters using this tool to do the heavy lifting, charging for the polish and curation on top.
A marketing agency offers 'content repurposing' for client webinars and podcasts, turning one long recording into a week of social posts at a fraction of the usual editing cost.
A SaaS reseller hosts a cloud version of the tool and charges creators a monthly fee who don't want to install and run desktop software themselves.

money_ideas.idea: Per-episode content-repurposing service charged to podcasters and creators
Monthly subscription for a hosted/cloud version aimed at creators who don't want to self-host

steal_this: This weekend, offer three local podcasters a free trial episode turned into 5 clips using this tool, then convert them to a $99/month 'never edit again' package.
